references.text: God calls Abram to go to a land He will show him, parallel to God's instruction to Isaac to stay in the land God assigns him.
Abraham goes down to Egypt during a famine – the direct parallel to Isaac's situation, but God commands Isaac not to do the same.
Abraham stays in Gerar, the same area where Isaac is when the Lord appears to him in 26:2.
The Lord appears again to Isaac and confirms the promise given to Abraham, a continuation of the revelation in verse 2.
God tells Jacob not to be afraid to go down to Egypt – a contrast to the instruction given to Isaac to stay in the land and not go to Egypt.
A clear parallel between the times of Isaac and Jeremiah: God warns both against fleeing to Egypt to avoid threat.
